verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that IP India keeps an Electronic Register of Patent Agents, lists of facilitators and IP Mitras, and a Forms & Official Fees page with downloadable forms. None of it describes what a third party may or may not do on an applicant's behalf, names an authorization or power-of-authority form, or says which signatures must stay personal. Rosters of registered intermediaries and a generic forms page are adjacent features, not a published delegation scope, so they earn no credit.
